papers.title: STELLA: Efficient Sensor-to-LLM Translation for On-Device Human Activity Recognition
papers.what: Reframes LLM-based activity recognition as sensor tokenization: a light hierarchical tokenizer turns wearable streams into activity-aware tokens for a frozen LLM, with on-device personalization, keeping recognition private and real-time on edge hardware.
papers.builds_on: Sensor2Text (Chen 2024); SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024); LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023)

papers.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.what: SpectraReward is a training-free RL reward for image generators: it grades an image by how well the prompt can be recovered from it in one forward pass, reusing a frozen MLLM's alignment with no labels or reward-model training.

papers.title: SIRI: Self-Internalizing Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Skills for LLM Agent Training
papers.what: A three-phase RL method that lets an agent mine skills from its own successful rollouts, validate them against skill-free runs, and distill only helpful action tokens into weights, so no skill bank or extra context is needed at inference.

papers.title: Extending LLM Context via Associative Recurrent Memory
papers.what: A recipe that extends usable context by placing associative recurrent memory in selected layers and training with a long-context curriculum, processing inputs past the original limit without full quadratic attention.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017); Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026)
